title: Listening Drill — Community mural
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Community mural
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on planning a community mural. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with school drawings. At the time our biggest obstacle was wall damage. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered shared themes. It helped us improve the design. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll show the revised plan to neighbours. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
